lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 to 12 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is relatively equidistant through the mid-torso with increased density toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 10th vertical line (counting from anterior), where the line splits into a Y-shape toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Discontinuous and abbreviated segments are visible on the 4th, 6th, and 11th lines, which terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 distinct white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh of the hind limb align horizontally, forming a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot located on the lower cheek below the eye; two distinct horizontal white bands across the throat and lower neck area.
